description: This file contains functions for masking and unmasking parts of markdown text, such as inline code, links, URLs, and placeholders, primarily used for internationalization or content processing.

methods.name: maskMarkdown
methods.description: Masks inline code, angle links, and link URLs in markdown text, replacing them with placeholders and storing mappings.

methods.name: maskMatches
methods.description: Helper function to find matches of a regex in the text, replace them with placeholders, and update the mapping.

methods.name: maskLinkURLs
methods.description: Finds link URLs in markdown text, replaces them with placeholders, and updates the mapping.

methods.name: unmaskMarkdown
methods.description: Replaces placeholders in the text back with their original markdown content based on the mapping.

methods.name: validatePlaceholders
methods.description: Checks that all placeholders are present in the text.
